[EN] If you think you're tough enough, give the Champions' Skyring battleground a try. No riff-raff, just gladiators who kill as often as they blink.
[ES] Si crees que eres lo suficientemente duro, prueba el campo de batalla de Champions' Skyring. Nada de chusma, solo gladiadores que matan tan seguido como parpadean.
